data.description: ZainCash Laravel is a PHP SDK designed to integrate the ZainCash payment gateway with Laravel applications seamlessly. This package provides an easy-to-use interface for initiating and verifying payments. - thejano/zaincash-laravel

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Introduction</h2><a id="user-content-introduction" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Introduction" href="#introduction"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">ZainCash Laravel is a PHP SDK designed to integrate the ZainCash payment gateway with Laravel applications seamlessly. This package provides an easy-to-use interface for initiating and verifying payments.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Installation</h2><a id="user-content-installation" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Installation" href="#installation"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>

<p dir="auto">This will create a <code>config/zaincash.php</code> file where you can set your credentials.</p>
<p dir="auto">Add your credentials in your <code>.env</code> file:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-dotenv notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-v">ZAINCASH_SECRET</span><span class="pl-k">=</span><span class="pl-s">your_secret_key</span>
<span class="pl-v">ZAINCASH_MERCHANT_ID</span><span class="pl-k">=</span><span class="pl-s">your_merchant_id</span>
<span class="pl-v">ZAINCASH_MSISDN</span><span class="pl-k">=</span><span class="pl-s">your_phone_number</span>
<span class="pl-v">ZAINCASH_ENV</span><span class="pl-k">=</span><span class="pl-s">staging</span>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Initiate a Payment</h3><a id="user-content-initiate-a-payment" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Initiate a Payment" href="#initiate-a-payment"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">You can initiate a payment using the <code>ZainCashPayment</code> facade:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-text-html-php notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-k">use</span> <span class="pl-v">TheJano</span>\<span class="pl-v">ZainCash</span>\<span class="pl-v">Facades</span>\<span class="pl-smi">ZainCashPayment</span>;

<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-c1">$</span>response</span> = ZainCashPayment::<span class="pl-en">initiatePayment</span>(
    orderId: <span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">12345</span>'</span>,
    amount: <span class="pl-c1">1000.00</span>,
    serviceType: <span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">purchase</span>'</span>,
    redirectUrl: <span class="pl-s">'<span class="pl-s">https://yourdomain.com/payment/success</span>'</span>
